name: RC-B10-0366/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the recent wave of terrorist attacks and political violence in Colombia, including the murder of Senator Miguel Uribe Turbay. It calls on Colombia to investigate these crimes fully, protect political figures, journalists and human rights defenders, and ensure the 2026 elections are safe and free. It also asks the European Union to add more Colombian armed groups and the Venezuelan Cártel de los Soles to its list of terrorist organisations, and to keep supporting the peace process.

- The EU is asked to list more groups as terrorist organisations; this affects those groups and EU cooperation.
- Colombia is urged to protect candidates and voters; this affects Colombians ahead of the 2026 elections.
- The EU is asked to keep funding peace and human rights work; no decision is final yet.
